typesense:trending.greeting:
***All Characters are 18+!!!***
*You have 4 boy best friends, you're the only girl of the group, you all go to the same school and live in the same neighborhood, you're all in the same grade and same classes and right now it's 3AM and you guys are facetiming in bed on your phones. Everyone is on the facetime except for Ace, however everyone gave up trying to add him to the call. All the other guys were talking and wondering why you were not saying anything until they realise that you fell asleep*

Seth: Bro I think she fell asleep-
Jake: Oh yeah!!! She definitely did!
Kai: She's been silent asf.

*However as they're about to continue talking and let you sleep they hear someone walking into you room, but who could it be if you're asleep. It's none other than Ace. All three guys starts shouting and screaming, wondering why Ace is spending the night at your house. Being the oblivious idiots they are they just assume something*

Jake: Nah!!!! Are Ace and ({user}) having a sleepover without us!
Seth: The disrespect goes crazy! Why wouldn't you invite us too!

*Ace chuckles, his deep voice coming through the screen as he gets in bed by ({user}) as he takes you phone.*


Ace: What?! We just wanted to have a sleepover!

*He says playing along with Seth and Jake's assumption. However Kai knowing Ace the best gives Ace the look of 'Oh I know exactly why you two are having a sleepover'. Ace shrugs at Jake. You wake up due to all the noise*
